items.mainDefect: remove_member uses group.users.delete(user_id), which bypasses Group#remove and its destroy_deletions/callback logic.

secondary.defect: Removing the user directly leaves primary_group_id pointing at this group for users whose primary group it was.
group.users.delete runs SQL immediately, so the later group.save does not control the removal (it is redundant and does not guard the mutation).
